observations.content: Assistant explained /md-log requires a filepath argument to an existing file (links into existing note, never creates) and requires the agent to be idle; typing /md-log without a path shows Usage warning; no writes to any file occurred after 21:00 so user's earlier attempt did not link successfully.
Assistant instructed user to type /md-log test-log.md while idle (test-log.md exists in workspace); expected status line showing the file and whole session backfilled to its tail.
/om:status live metrics showed context at 128,638/150,000 (86%, 3rd compaction imminent), journey at 1,903/1,000 tok (double target, consolidator will trim), pool at 14,443 consolidating at 15,000.
User stated they already logged to file test-log-2.md.

Test of /md-log confirmed fully working: test-log-2.md is 125,503 bytes updated 14:16 UTC, contains backfilled session history plus live mirroring of current exchange with Obsidian callouts ([!quote] YOU and [!abstract] PI), capturing even the in-progress turn.

Assistant closed out the day's 5 test items: YouTube frames (infra fixed via yt-dlp + node runtime + ffmpeg), guided-choice (unreachable by design), PDF scan (E2E + vision via MiniMax-M3 [V]), user-side commands (/om:status + /md-log run through Paseo chat, compaction auto-fired 2x), and web_search providers (exa/jina/duckduckgo alive, others need keys).
Plus today: OM INDEX bug fix + data repair, model audit of 5 models (MiniMax = think-leak), channel 3 semantics E2E, researcher merge, 40+ agents cleaned up.
Assistant reiterated pending decision: switching scout model from MiniMax-M3 to glm-5.3-flash (clean format, same [V], cheaper), a one-line change in scout.md.

User reported the stop bug recurred at 21:18 (timer kept running after finish; only their STOP made the assistant continue) and that the memory index appeared to be moved into a nested dir again, asking whether it is a bug or intended.

Disk verified clean for current session 01a0522e-81f4-7311-8ba4-027cea97e974: outer level has INDEX.md, JOURNEY.md + 7 topic files, no nested .memory dir; consolidator ran at 14:16 on fixed code writing 6/9 topic files correctly at top level with INDEX re-rendered 14:19:00.

First investigation used wrong SID 01a0521e before correcting to 01a0522e; buildWorkerArgv in launch.ts loads extension via -e agentExtensionPath with --no-extensions/--no-skills/--no-prompt-templates/--no-context-files/--no-builtin-tools flags.
The two older session dirs (01a0521d, 01a0521e from morning pre-fix runs) each contain only a hidden subdir (likely .runs artifacts), no nested topic dirs; assistant offered to delete them.

Assistant concluded memory is not a bug: paths listed in INDEX as .memory/<sessionId>/topic.md are the intended per-session layout (2 levels deep from project root), not files moved; find across whole tree showed no nested .memory remained.

Assistant diagnosed stop bug as one root cause (dropped finish notification leaving daemon stuck in running state) with 3 symptoms: spinner keeps spinning, timer keeps running, new user messages get swallowed/queued as followUp until STOP forces an abort and releases the queue.

Assistant's golden rule for the stop bug: when answer looks complete and spinner still spins, press STOP immediately; nothing is lost and it frees stuck messages; offered to draft an upstream bug report for Paseo given 3 reproductions.
User reported the stop bug happened again at 21:21 (seems recurring) and asked to check the Paseo repo for existing bug reports of this issue.

Local process check identified the product: paseo daemon installed via @getpaseo/cli npm, daemon on 127.0.0.1:6767, version 0.6.1, running as Paseo Supervisor + Paseo Daemon + paseo-relay; repo is github.com/getpaseo/paseo.

Web search found existing Paseo GitHub issues matching the bug: issue 3845 'bug(pi): process completion wake leaves agent stuck running' and issue 3847 'Pi autonomous turns remain running after settlement' (agent stuck running when out-of-band turn finishes without triggering completion notification since activeTurnId stays null, fixed by PRs 3849 and 3848), plus PR 2066 'Fix Pi slash commands hanging after local completion'.
